name: mapcollector
description: A fun game to explore public transportation systems from around the world
author: Gustav Lindberg

scripts.preinstall:
cmd /c exit || sudo apt install android-sdk && sudo chown -R $(whoami):$(whoami) /usr/lib/android-sdk && mkdir -p /usr/lib/android-sdk/licenses && echo -e 
d56f5187479451eabf01fb78af6dfcb131a6481e > /usr/lib/android-sdk/licenses/android-sdk-license && echo -e 
84831b9409646a918e30573bab4c9c91346d8abd > /usr/lib/android-sdk/licenses/android-sdk-preview-license && echo -e 
601085b94cd77f0b54ff86406957099ebe79c4d6 > /usr/lib/android-sdk/licenses/android-googletv-license && echo -e 
33b6a2b64607f11b759f320ef9dff4ae5c47d97a > /usr/lib/android-sdk/licenses/google-gdk-license && echo -e 
d975f751698a77b662f1254ddbeed3901e976f5a > /usr/lib/android-sdk/licenses/intel-android-extra-license && echo -e 
e9acab5b5fbb560a72cfaecce8946896ff6aab9d > /usr/lib/android-sdk/licenses/mips-android-sysimage-license
scripts.build: npx tsc -p src && npx uglifyjs-folder app/app/src/main/assets/static/js -o app/app/src/main/assets/static/js -x .js -e && adb shell true && cd app && ( ./gradlew --stop || gradlew.bat --stop ) && ( ANDROID_HOME=/usr/lib/android-sdk ./gradlew assembleDebug || gradlew.bat assembleDebug ) && adb install app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && adb shell monkey -p tk.mapcollector 1
